The verdicts for visible features (symmetry, voluminous cut, sleeve drape, matte fabric) are accurate and align with the visual evidence. artifact_review: The Router's severity ratings were appropriate but perhaps slightly conservative regarding the background figure. The 'structural_collapse' of the foreground hand (severity 3.0) is well-justified by the visual ambiguity and supported by the Pose Auditor's low-confidence wrist/elbow keypoints. The 'texture_anomaly' in the background face (severity 2.5) is confirmed by the high ratio of low-confidence facial/limb keypoints in Instance 2. I am upgrading the severity of the background artifacts slightly because the Pose Auditor indicates a 'HIGH' risk level (71% low confidence), suggesting the distortion is more than just 'slight smearing'—it represents a fundamental failure in anatomical coherence for the secondary subject. The tassel blur (severity 1.5) is minor and consistent with depth-of-field, so I agree with the Router there.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'academic gown' class. The Fine Grained Classifier provided high-confidence confirmation (Logit 7.66). All testable diagnostic checkpoints (symmetry, sleeve drape, fabric texture) passed verification. The primary deduction comes from the structural integrity of the human subjects rather than the gown itself.
artifact_reasoning: Significant artifacts detected in human anatomy. The foreground subject's hand exhibits structural collapse (merged fingers/grip ambiguity), corroborated by low-confidence pose keypoints in the wrist/elbow region. The background subject shows severe facial and limb distortion, evidenced by smeared teeth/mouth and a 71% low-confidence keypoint ratio from the Pose Auditor. While the gown itself is clean, the biological subjects contain notable generative failures.
